skills.name: brand-kit-assistant
skills.description_zh: 协助设置和使用 Contentstack Brand Kit、Voice Profiles 与 Knowledge Vault，将品牌治理和获批资料用于 AI 内容生成；核对所需标识、区域、授权及资料来源。

skills.name: cms-assets
skills.description_zh: 组织、发布、交付和转换 Contentstack 图片及媒体，涵盖目录命名、Image Delivery API、响应式图片、发布/取消/替换生命周期、CDN 和常见限制。

skills.name: cms-branches-aliases
skills.description_zh: 使用 Contentstack branches 隔离内容开发、aliases 支持无停机部署，说明分支策略、全局/分支模块、合并、CI/CD 和回滚。

skills.name: cms-data-modeling-best-practices
skills.name_hint: cms · 数据 · modeling · best · practices
skills.description_zh: 设计、审查或重构 Contentstack 内容模型，选择 content type、reference、global field、group、modular block、JSON RTE、taxonomy 或 tag，避免过度建模和过深引用并保持编辑与查询简洁。

skills.name: cms-entries
skills.description_zh: 指导 Contentstack entries 查询、本地化、版本和发布，涵盖 CDA、引用展开、分页、批量与 Sync API，说明响应结构及前端误用 CMA 等问题。

skills.name: cms-environments-publishing
skills.description_zh: 指导 Contentstack 环境与发布管道，说明 delivery/preview token、Sync API、排期、发布队列、CDN 与缓存，保持前端和内容状态同步。

skills.name: cms-live-preview-visual-builder-support-assistant
headings: Live Preview and Visual Builder Support Assistant
skills.name_hint: cms · live · preview · visual · builder · support · assistant
skills.description_zh: 排查 Contentstack Live Preview 与 Visual Builder 的空白、旧内容、导航上下文丢失、缓存混用和编辑标签映射问题，结合 CSR、SSR、SSG 或中间层结构提出修复。

skills.name: cms-localization
skills.description_zh: 指导 Contentstack 多语言配置、回退链、本地化/非本地化 entry、字段级选择和多地区发布，区分 CMS 编辑体验与 CDA 交付行为。

skills.name: cms-releases
skills.description_zh: 使用 Contentstack Releases 协调相关内容原子发布，涵盖创建、条目管理、分阶段部署、排期、webhook 风暴缓解和 CI/CD 集成及限制。

skills.name: cms-roles-permissions
skills.description_zh: 设计 Contentstack 内置/自定义角色、团队与 token 权限，说明权限合并和最小授权，区分安全的客户端 token 与服务端凭据并提示限流/SSO 边界。

skills.name: cms-taxonomy
skills.description_zh: 指导 Contentstack Taxonomy 分类层级设计和交付端筛选，比较 taxonomy 与 tags/labels/references，说明 CDA 操作符、本地化及导入导出。

skills.name: cms-tokens-authentication
skills.description_zh: 为 Contentstack 前端、后端、自动化和第三方应用选择认证与 token 类型，说明客户端/服务端安全使用、凭据处理、限流和 SSO 注意事项。

skills.name: cms-variants-personalization
skills.description_zh: 指导 Contentstack Variants/Personalize 受众个性化与 A/B 测试，比较变体和独立 entry、解释 variant group 和 CMS 集成，避免复制整条内容或过度复杂。

skills.name: cms-webhooks
skills.description_zh: 配置消费 Contentstack webhook，选择事件、处理 payload、签名、重试、重复投递、发布风暴与失败，建立可靠接收端并连接重建、索引、Slack 或 CI/CD。

skills.name: cms-workflows
skills.description_zh: 设计 Contentstack 工作流和发布规则，规划阶段、转换限制、审批、发布治理与自动化钩子，防止自我审批和权限缺口，并明确范围/限制。

skills.name: developer-hub-app-architect
skills.description_zh: 为 Contentstack Developer Hub 或 Marketplace 应用选择界面位置、设计架构并生成 React/TypeScript 起始代码，也用于排查 manifest、SDK、代理、OAuth 和 iframe 问题。

skills.name: dx-delivery-sdk
skills.description_zh: 编写和核对 Contentstack TypeScript Delivery SDK 代码，处理条目、资源、引用、筛选、排序、分页、多语言及预览集成，并依据 SDK 规格检查调用链。

skills.name: dx-migrate-js-to-ts-sdk
skills.name_hint: dx · migrate · js · to · ts · sdk
skills.description_zh: 将 Contentstack Delivery SDK 的 JavaScript 实现迁移至 TypeScript SDK，核对查询、分页、资源、缓存、分类和图像功能的接口差异，尽量保持原有行为。

skills.name: launch-sync-environment-variables-from-env-example
skills.name_hint: launch · 同步 · environment · variables · from · env · example
skills.description_zh: 比较 Contentstack Launch 目标环境变量与本地 .env.example，审计缺失键并通过项目接口补齐，适用于部署前配置一致性检查。

skills.name: launch-trigger-and-monitor-launch-deployments
skills.name_hint: launch · trigger · and · 监控 · launch · deployments
skills.description_zh: 为指定 Contentstack Launch 项目和环境触发部署并轮询至结束，失败或取消时读取日志、诊断原因并给出下一步建议。

skills.description_zh: 协助将 Contentful 的内容类型、条目、资源和语言配置迁移至 Contentstack；先用 CLI 迁移内容并核对数量，再处理网站代码，按步骤保留工作目录和产物。

skills.name: brand-kit-assistant
skills.description: Advise users on Contentstack Brand Kit concepts, setup, governance, and on-brand AI generation. Route API-specific tasks to the right Brand Kit capability or reference skill, and enforce brand and safety rules before presenting anything as ready.

skills.name: cms-assets
skills.description: Advise developers on organizing, delivering, and transforming assets in Contentstack. Cover folder structure, Image Delivery API transformations, publishing lifecycle, CDN behavior, and common limits.

skills.name: cms-branches-aliases
skills.description: Advise developers on using Contentstack branches for isolated content development and aliases for zero-downtime content deployments. Cover branch strategy, branch-specific vs global modules, CI/CD integration, merge behavior, and rollback patterns.

skills.name: cms-data-modeling-best-practices
skills.description: Guide developers to model content in Contentstack using the simplest reusable structure. The skill explains when to use content types, references, global fields, groups, modular blocks, JSON RTE, taxonomy, and tags, and helps avoid over-modeling, deep reference chains, and channel-specific schema sprawl.
skills.name_hint: cms · 数据 · modeling · best · practices

skills.name: cms-entries
skills.description: Advise developers on querying, localizing, versioning, publishing, and structuring Contentstack entries for efficient delivery. Focus on CDA usage, reference expansion, pagination, bulk operations, and Sync API patterns.

skills.name: cms-environments-publishing
skills.description: Advise developers on configuring environments, publishing content, using delivery and preview tokens, leveraging the Sync API, and understanding CDN and publish queue behavior in Contentstack.

skills.name: cms-live-preview-visual-builder-support-assistant
skills.description: Diagnose and guide Contentstack Live Preview and Visual Builder implementations. Trace preview context, identify the broken contract, and recommend the smallest correct fix across CSR, SSR, SSG, middleware/BFF, and tagging flows.
headings: Live Preview and Visual Builder Support Assistant
skills.name_hint: cms · live · preview · visual · builder · support · assistant

skills.name: cms-localization
skills.description: Advise developers on Contentstack localization: language setup, fallback chains, localized vs unlocalized entries, non-localizable fields, and multi-locale publishing.

skills.name: cms-releases
skills.description: Advise developers on using Contentstack Releases for coordinated, atomic content deployment. Cover release creation, item management, staged deployment, webhook storm prevention, and CI/CD integration.

skills.name: cms-roles-permissions
skills.description: Advise developers on designing roles, permissions, teams, and token access in Contentstack. Explain built-in roles, custom roles, permission merging, team-based access, and token capabilities with least-privilege guidance.

skills.name: cms-taxonomy
skills.description: Advise developers on using Contentstack Taxonomy for structured, hierarchical content classification and delivery-side filtering. Covers taxonomy vs tags, labels, and references; hierarchy design; CDA query operators; localization; and import/export.

skills.name: cms-tokens-authentication
skills.description: Advise developers on choosing the right Contentstack authentication method and token type for frontend, backend, automation, and third-party app use cases. Include security guidance, rate-limit awareness, and SSO considerations.

skills.name: cms-variants-personalization
skills.description: Advise developers on using Contentstack Variants and Personalize for audience-targeted content. Explain when to use variants versus separate entries, how variant groups work, and how to integrate Personalize with the CMS.

skills.name: cms-webhooks
skills.description: Advise developers on configuring and consuming Contentstack webhooks for real-time event notifications. Cover event channels, payload structure, signature verification, retry behavior, release-triggered webhook storms, and reliable receiver design.

skills.name: cms-workflows
skills.description: Advise developers on designing and configuring Contentstack workflows and publish rules for content governance. Cover stage design, transition restrictions, approval flows, publish governance, automation hooks, and common pitfalls.

skills.name: developer-hub-app-architect
skills.description: Turn Contentstack Developer Hub and Marketplace app ideas into concrete implementations. Choose the right UI location, map the architecture, generate boilerplate-aligned React/TypeScript code, and troubleshoot setup, SDK, manifest, proxy, and publishing issues.

skills.name: dx-delivery-sdk
skills.description: Help agents write correct, production-ready TypeScript using `@contentstack/delivery-sdk` for Contentstack entries, assets, references, filtering, sorting, pagination, locale, Live Preview, and Visual Builder support. Verify SDK behavior against the Delivery SDK Spec when method names, options, or chain order matter.

skills.name: dx-migrate-js-to-ts-sdk
skills.description: Migrate Contentstack Delivery SDK code from JavaScript to TypeScript. Rewrite setup, initialization, Stack, Entries, Assets, Query, pagination, cache, utils, taxonomy, and image transform usage while preserving behavior and calling out TypeScript-specific differences.
skills.name_hint: dx · migrate · js · to · ts · sdk

skills.name: launch-sync-environment-variables-from-env-example
skills.description: Fetch environment variables from a Contentstack Launch project, compare them with a local `.env.example` file, and patch the target environment to add any missing keys.
skills.name_hint: launch · 同步 · environment · variables · from · env · example

skills.name: launch-trigger-and-monitor-launch-deployments
skills.description: Trigger a Launch deployment for a specific environment, then poll its status until completion. If the deployment fails or is cancelled, fetch the deployment log and diagnose likely causes with next-step recommendations.
skills.name_hint: launch · trigger · and · 监控 · launch · deployments

skills.name: contentstack-migration-companion
skills.description: Migration companion for moving to Contentstack from another CMS. Guides content and application migration through a structured, step-by-step workflow. Currently supports migrations from Contentful, with additional source platforms planned. Use when users want to migrate, move, switch, port, or re-platform to Contentstack, including content models, content, assets, locales, application integrations, or website code. Trigger on requests such as "migrate to Contentstack", "move to Contentstack", "switch to Contentstack", "migrate from Contentful", "move my Contentful space", "port my CMS", or similar migration-related requests. The skill validates prerequisites, guides the migration process, provides progress checkpoints, and delivers a completion summary. Prefer this skill whenever a Contentstack migration is requested.
